name: Article Cards with Category Badges
Primary CTA Button
role: Main call-to-action, most prominent interactive element
description: Background #27ae60, white text, 999px radius (full pill), 13px top/bottom padding, 28px left/right padding. Weight 600, 16px. The same shape and color appears on both dark and light backgrounds — the green reads clearly on either surface. Arrow glyph appended inline (→).

name: Ghost Green Button
role: Secondary CTA beside primary button, typically 'See more' or 'Learn more'
description: Transparent background, #27ae60 text and border, 999px radius, 0px top/bottom padding (height set by line-height), 30px left/right padding. Appears paired with the filled green button to create a primary/secondary hierarchy without introducing a second color.

name: Outlined Dark Button
role: Tertiary action on light sections, e.g. 'Browse articles'
description: White background, #313942 text and border, 17px radius (not a pill — distinct from CTAs), 7px top/bottom padding, 19px left/right padding. The non-pill radius on this variant signals a different interaction tier from the rounded CTAs.

name: Ghost White Button
role: Navigation-level or overlay actions on dark sections
description: Transparent background, white text and border, 999px radius (pill), 0px vertical padding, 40px horizontal padding. Used in dark-hero contexts where the green primary isn't needed.

name: Navigation Sign Up Button
role: Primary conversion entry point in sticky nav bar
description: #f49a40 background (amber-orange), white text, 999px radius, matching padding to ghost white button. The amber color is unique to this one button site-wide — it's not part of the standard CTA system, deliberately distinguishing account creation from feature CTAs.

name: Feature Product Card
role: Large showcase card for a named product (Postcards, Slides, Startup)
description: Background #edf9f2 (Mint Card), 32px border radius, no box-shadow, 50px padding all sides. Contains product logo, headline at 32px weight 700, body text at 16px #313942, and a ghost green button. The mint tint ties the card visually to the green brand without using the full #27ae60.

name: Stats Counter Card
description: White or #f4f7f2 background, 20px radius, 32-40px padding. Display numeral at 57px weight 700, tracking -1.6px, line-height 1.0. Descriptor text at 14-16px weight 400 #313942. Three cards in a 3-column grid, separated by subtle #e4ebe2 borders.

name: Category Badge
role: Article taxonomy tag on blog cards
description: Background #ff5722 (orange), white text, 6px radius, 4px vertical padding, 8px horizontal padding, 11px font size weight 500. The orange reads vividly against both the dark article section background and the card thumbnail images.

name: Success/Status Badge
description: Background #27ae60, white text, 6px radius, 0px vertical padding, 6px horizontal padding. The same green as the CTA button, keeping semantic and brand signals unified.

name: Tab Navigation
description: Transparent background tabs with 16px text, active tab underlined with #27ae60 2px border-bottom, inactive tabs in #879b93 (Fog). Set on the dark hero, tabs provide product switching without a separate page load. Active label in white, inactive in Fog.

name: Product Screenshot Frame
role: App UI screenshot within hero or feature sections
description: 12–32px border radius on the image container. Drop shadow: rgba(17, 50, 38, 0.14) 14px 17px 40px 0px — a green-tinted shadow that stays on-brand even for elevation. Screenshots are displayed at full card width, never cropped to icons.

name: Logo Bar (Social Proof Strip)
role: Trust logos row — Twilio, Toptal, Vodafone, Yelp, etc.
description: Full-width horizontal strip on #0e231c dark background, white SVG logos at reduced opacity. No borders or separators between logos. Functions as a pure social proof divider between the hero and the stats section.
